omnigate.title: OmniGate - AI Master — Omni Solutions Global® Company Limited
omnigate.subtitle: Interface control for barrier systems
omnigate.pageDesc:
OmniGate - AI Master is the professional, intelligent high-end control center for synchronized management and monitoring of automated gate systems, security fences, and router networks. The app connects via encrypted protocols directly to the control electronics of your access points and the firmware of your network routers.

Through integrated, advanced AI speech processing, the app understands natural voice commands instantly and executes them in milliseconds. That means maximum accessibility: a simple spoken sentence is enough to open, close, or lock heavy industrial gates, garage doors, or security swing gates.

In the network domain, the integrated AI master monitors router activity, secures Wi-Fi against unauthorized access, and optimizes data flows fully automatically. The app requires no manual language settings; it detects the smartphone system language at startup and seamlessly adapts the entire user interface and voice feedback. Download is accessible via the universal QR code with automatic routing for iOS and Android systems, including Google Play and the alternative Aptoide platform.
omnigate.frontWerbetext: Security and convenience on an entirely new level — that is OmniGate - AI Master! Why struggle with complicated remotes, vulnerable keypad locks, or unreliable networks? This app is the right choice because it unites full control over your automated gate systems and your entire router infrastructure in a single, highly secure platform. You never have to hunt for buttons or painstakingly type passwords again. Simply speak to your app! It was purpose-built to work fully accessibly via voice command — ideal for maximum convenience and essential for people with physical limitations. Trust German engineering quality combined with smart AI security for your home. Get master control now via the universal QR code on the Play Store or Aptoide! By tapping the app icon you land in the App Store or Play Store intended for your device.

The app operates fluently in multiple languages and automatically detects the smartphone's preset system language to ensure accessible handling without manual configuration. omnifix.frontWerbetext: Elevate your documents, contracts, and correspondence to absolute premium level! omniqr.meta: OmniQR-AI for Tourist of Thailand — Omni Solutions Global® Company Limited
omniqr.title: OmniQR-AI for Tourist of Thailand — Omni Solutions Global® Company Limited
omniqr.subtitle: Payment API for the tourism sector
omniqr.pageDesc:
OmniQR-AI for Tourist of Thailand is a highly advanced, AI-driven cross-border payment system that establishes a direct interface with the Thai PromptPay standard and international payment systems. Core functionality is built on an accessible voice and recognition matrix designed specifically for comfortable, unrestricted use.

The user does not need to manually enter numeric values into an input field. Instead, they communicate directly with the app by voice. AI instantly recognizes the smartphone's country of origin and automatically switches the user interface and speech recognition to the respective system language (e.g. German, Thai, or Polish).

When scanning a PromptPay QR code, the app determines the Thai baht amount, converts it in real time at the current live rate into the user's home currency (such as Euro or Złoty), and securely executes the transaction after biometric confirmation. The system is highly optimized for cross-platform distribution via a universal QR code that intelligently routes users to the Google Play Store, Apple App Store, or Aptoide depending on their device.
omniqr.descTitle: OmniQR-AI for Tourist of Thailand — Description
omniqr.frontWerbetext: Paying in Thailand has never been so elegant, fast, and secure! OmniQR-AI for Tourist of Thailand is the ultimate companion for tourists, business travelers, and locals alike. Why is this app the best choice for payments? Because it makes the hassle of chasing cash, overpriced exchange booths, and complicated bank forms completely obsolete. With this app, you are instantly part of Thailand's modern PromptPay network. The special advantage: you do not have to painstakingly enter amounts on screen or convert figures in your head. Simply speak to the app! Artificial intelligence understands you in your native language, converts currencies such as Euro or Złoty in real time, and completes the payment in seconds. End payment stress on holiday and choose maximum security and accessibility. Scan the universal QR code and get started with confidence! By tapping the app icon you land in the App Store or Play Store intended for your device.

omniaiQr.title: OmniAI-QR Code Generator — Omni Solutions Global® Company Limited
omniaiQr.subtitle: Dynamic industrial QR codes
omniaiQr.pageDesc:
The OmniAI-QR Code Generator is a professional, AI-powered application for creating and managing dynamic, universal QR codes for advanced marketing and distribution structures. The application differs fundamentally from static systems through its integrated intelligent routing technology.

A QR code generated with this app analyzes the metadata of the accessing device at the moment of scanning. It detects the specific operating system (iOS, standard Android, or open Android systems) as well as the user's preset system language. Based on this data, the code routes the user via a dynamic switch directly to the appropriate destination.

In this way, cross-platform downloads (such as seamless assignment between Google Play Store and Aptoide for Android users) can be realized through a single printed or digital code. The app interface automatically adapts to the smartphone system language, is fully accessible to operate, and integrates seamlessly into the floating, chrome-finished 3D design of the corporate group. Download of the app is via the homepage's universal QR system.
omniaiQr.frontWerbetext: Create the smartest and most powerful QR codes in modern marketing! The OmniAI-QR Code Generator is the professional all-in-one platform for future-proof customer routing and dynamic marketing. Why is this app the best choice for your business? Because conventional, static QR codes simply are not enough today. This app generates universal, AI-driven marketing codes that think ahead: when scanned, they automatically detect the customer's device operating system and route users instantly to the exactly right store — whether Google Play, Apple App Store, or Aptoide! Perfect for posters, flyers, and digital media. The app is extremely easy to use, runs fully automatically in your smartphone language, and offers maximum clarity. Make your marketing measurable and efficient. Download the app now via the universal download code and get started! By tapping the app icon you land in the App Store or Play Store intended for your device.

omnicad.meta: OmniCAD-AI CAM — Omni Solutions Global® Company Limited
omnicad.title: OmniCAD-AI CAM — Omni Solutions Global® Company Limited
omnicad.subtitle: AI-powered CAD/CAM automation
omnicad.pageDesc:
OmniCAD-AI CAM is the revolutionary, AI-powered complete solution for millimeter-accurate capture, technical drawing, and material calculation of rooms. The workflow is groundbreaking in its simplicity: the user stands in the center of the room and captures the entire surroundings in a single panoramic sweep with the camera. Artificial intelligence analyzes the video footage in real time and automatically generates a highly precise technical 3D drawing including all exact wall lengths, heights, and angles.

The app includes specialized modules for every trade:

  • FOR PAINTERS AND WALLPAPERERS: Instantly calculates the exact surface area of walls and ceilings. It outputs the precise quantity of wall paint, primer, or plaster required — directly in kilograms or liters.
  • FOR FLOORING INSTALLERS: Determines the exact square meterage for tiles, parquet, or laminate and automatically factors in necessary cutting waste, so you buy exactly what you need.
  • FOR ELECTRICIANS: AI analyzes the room and shows strategically optimal placements for new outlets and switches. At the same time, the app calculates the exact cable length required for installation.
  • FOR PLUMBERS: Provides intelligent structuring for bathrooms and toilets to position connections and fixtures in a space-saving, code-compliant layout.

The app runs entirely in the background in the operating system language, offers maximum accessibility through intuitive guidance, and routes users via the integrated universal QR code to the correct app store across platforms (including full Aptoide support for open Android devices).
omnicad.frontWerbetext: Say goodbye to tape measures, inaccurate sketches, and nasty surprises when buying materials! OmniCAD-AI CAM is the definitive milestone for the job site and home renovation. Why is this app the right choice for you? Because it transforms complex engineering into an effortless one-click solution. You do not need to be a professional or learn complicated software. The app turns your smartphone into an intelligent, vision-enabled site manager that thinks ahead, saves costs, and eliminates errors before they happen. Whether you are a professional tradesperson looking to save time or a homeowner who wants to renovate perfectly — this app has you covered. It is radically accessible, extremely fast, and automatically adapts to your smartphone language. Scan the universal QR code and experience the future of space planning. Android users enjoy complete freedom when downloading — choose between the Google Play Store and Aptoide! By tapping the app icon you land in the App Store or Play Store intended for your device.

about.meta: About us — Omni Solutions Global Company Limited®
about.title: About us
about.subtitle: The architectural peak of next-generation technology
about.body:
We do not merely ship apps. We build the digital nervous systems that tomorrow’s markets will run on.

Omni Solutions Global Company Limited® is a highly specialized technological elite forge at the intersection of hyper-scalable architecture, encrypted data flows, and disruptive artificial intelligence. Under one corporate roof we design, operate, and continuously harden flagship products that must work in the real world — not as demos, but as living systems.

Every product currently listed in our portfolio is a flagship: Pauli BestPrice Global® (Thailand market), OmniGate - AI Master, OmniFIX - AI Document Assistant, OmniQR-AI for Tourists of Thailand, Omni King AI Trading, OmniAI-QR Code Generator, OmniCAD-AI CAM, and OmniTalk-AI Live. None of them is a side project. Each one proves what we can transfer into client architectures as bespoke high-end systems.

We are among the first to dare putting under one roof what the industry still treats as separate worlds: intelligent price discovery and uncompromising accessibility for people with disabilities — voice-first operation without keyboard or manual screen input. To our knowledge, no application worldwide combines this depth of market intelligence with that level of barrier-free control in a single product.

Those who commission us are not looking for templates. They want absolute technological leadership in their sector — and a partner that builds as if the company’s own reputation were on the line. Because it is.

What we do for enterprises

1. Disruptive Hyper-AI & predictive analytics

Artificial intelligence is the foundation layer of our architecture, not a bolt-on. We design neural filters, real-time verification, multimodal voice interfaces, and computer-vision pipelines that turn unstructured reality into actionable structure.

2. High-performance cross-platform engineering

iOS, Android, and Web without system borders — tuned for throughput, fault tolerance, and clean-code latency discipline under global load.

3. Secure enterprise infrastructure

Encrypted control planes, integrity feedback, and operational discipline so flagship products remain trustworthy when money, identity, or physical access are at stake.

Omni Solutions Global does not chase trends. We forge systems that must still work when the trend has moved on.

omnitalk.meta: OmniTalk-AI Live — Omni Solutions Global® Company Limited
omnitalk.title: OmniTalk-AI Live — Omni Solutions Global® Company Limited
omnitalk.subtitle: Real-time AI voice communication
omnitalk.pageDesc:
OmniTalk-AI Live is a revolutionary, AI-powered communication application for fully automatic real-time simultaneous interpretation of ongoing phone calls. The technological innovation of this app lies in its deep system integration: the program requires no manual activation and no calling through a separate third-party platform.

As soon as a regular phone call arrives on the smartphone and the system registers a foreign language, AI switches on fully automatically and without activation delay directly into the audio data stream of the call. The app analyzes spoken words in real time, translates them in a fraction of a second into the user's native language, and plays back the result.

For the other party, the translation is output via an advanced Voice-Cloning module — meaning the conversation partner hears the translation in their own language, yet it is acoustically generated with the user's familiar voice and intonation. The system is uncompromisingly accessible, reads all menu items aloud in the detected system language, and is displayed on the website as a freely floating, chrome-finished 3D handset symbol without background. Download is via the universal QR code with integrated routing for Google Play and Aptoide.
omnitalk.frontWerbetext: Break down every language barrier in the world in a single second — right while you are on a normal phone call! OmniTalk-AI Live is the absolute sensation in the communications market and the right choice for worldwide connections. Why do you need this app on your smartphone immediately? Because it ends misunderstandings and complicated translation tools. Imagine: someone calls you and speaks Thai, Polish, or English. You do not need to open a separate app, press buttons, or activate anything. OmniTalk-AI Live automatically hooks directly into your ongoing phone call, recognizes the foreign language in real time, and interprets the conversation in a fraction of a second! And the best part: the app does not translate with a robotic computer voice — it uses your own AI-adapted voice for the other party! Call customers, friends, or authorities worldwide as if you were speaking the same language. Scan the universal QR code and get this groundbreaking technology now on the Play Store or Aptoide! By tapping the app icon you land in the App Store or Play Store intended for your device.

The AI bot is capable of processing vast volumes of data, chart patterns, and historical trends in parallel to make trading decisions with maximum statistical probability of success. The system works fully autonomously, executes profit-optimized market actions independently, protects invested capital through automated risk management protocols, and removes the human factor.

The user interface is uncompromisingly accessible and adapts instantly to the smartphone operating system language without manual setup. For quick access, the app is integrated on the homepage via a freestanding, reflective 3D symbol and is distributed via a universal QR code with intelligent routing for iOS and Android (including Google Play Store and Aptoide connectivity).
omniKing.frontWerbetext: Let the most powerful artificial intelligence in the financial world work around the clock for your financial success! Omni King AI Trading is the exclusive trading and market optimization app for crypto and financial markets. Why is this app the best choice for you? Because it completely eliminates emotional stress, hours of staring at charts, and the risk of poor decisions. While you sleep, our state-of-the-art AI bot analyzes global markets in millisecond cycles, identifies rising trends, and optimizes trading strategies fully autonomously for maximum profit. The app is structured so simply that both beginners and professionals achieve maximum results immediately. It speaks your language, works fully automatically, and is absolutely secure. Bet on the future of intelligent wealth building. Scan the universal QR code and activate your personal AI profit bot today via the Play Store or Aptoide! By tapping the app icon you land in the App Store or Play Store intended for your device.

ozgs.title: Omni Zero Gate Security
ozgs.lead: Next-generation zero-knowledge security infrastructure for institutions that cannot compromise.
ozgs.intro: Ladies and gentlemen. We hereby present our future vision of uncompromising security infrastructure: Omni Solutions Global is currently developing the next generation of Omni Zero Gate Security. In an increasingly connected yet massively threatened digital era, institutions, law firms and enterprises face a fundamental challenge. Whether attorneys and court offices handling highly sensitive mandate and litigation traffic, insurers protecting regulated policyholder data and policies, municipal bodies and city halls exchanging confidential data continuously, medical chambers and healthcare systems, or the critical IT infrastructure of major industrial operations — anyone responsible for sensitive information that must be transmitted at the highest level of security can accept no compromise and must not rely on fragile standard clouds. Our forthcoming architecture breaks with the weaknesses of conventional software. The system is built on an uncompromising zero-knowledge approach: all data is encrypted decentralized and directly on the endpoint before it travels even a centimetre. No one — not even we as developers — ever gains insight into the plaintext infrastructure. This vision is reinforced by pioneering controls: an external recipient such as a court or authority needs no software licence and accesses content through a protected, ephemeral web container. The sender retains full control via a central dashboard and can revoke access within seconds. Dynamic personalised watermarks make any analogue leak immediately traceable, while multi-combo access and biometric verification shut out unauthorised use from the outset. Development of this landmark security infrastructure is advancing at full speed. Stay curious. Be ready to be surprised. Or is this exactly the technological solution you and your institution have been searching for?
